resources.string: Only enabled site rules allow background playback. If none are enabled, background playback pauses. Tap a site to view its scope and change its rule.
The mode is off. Saved rules do not restrict or enable playback; the browser works as usual.

This mode controls background playback for your selected HTTPS sites. It is off by default, with no preconfigured domains.

Enter a site domain without a scheme, path, port or wildcard. Unicode domains are supported. IP addresses and whole public or private registries, such as co.uk or github.io, cannot be added.

Each rule has its own permission, time limit and subdomain scope. Exact duplicates are rejected. Overlapping rules are allowed as exceptions: the most specific matching domain wins, including a disabled rule.

One elapsed-time limit is shared by all tabs and windows using the same rule. Pausing, reloading, changing a rule or deleting and re-adding it does not renew the timer. Return to the actual site with the screen unlocked to reset it.

Save applies all editor changes together. Turning the mode off pauses current background sessions once and restores normal browser behavior. Some sites may still restrict playback.
When enabled, only your allowed sites can play in the background. When disabled, the browser works as usual.
No sites yet. Add the sites you want to listen to.

One limit is shared by a site\'s tabs for the whole background session, including time with the screen off. Pausing or waking the screen does not reset it. Return to the site to reset the limit. Some sites may still restrict playback.
Enter a site domain without https://, a path or a port, for example youtube.com or пример.рф.
Not applied while the mode is off
No other saved rules overlap this scope.

These saved rules overlap the current scope:
%1$s

An overlapping domain can have its own permission and time limit. The rules are retained separately.
The most specific matching domain takes priority, even if its rule is disabled. A rule without subdomains affects only that exact domain. Sibling domains do not overlap.
From 1 minute to 2 hours. Playback pauses when the limit expires.
Apply the domain, permission, scope and limit together
Delete the background playback rule for %1$s?
With the mode enabled, %1$s will no longer have a matching permission rule.

After deletion, %1$s will use this broader rule:
%2$s

Deleting this exception can therefore change whether background playback is allowed.
Enter a valid site domain without a scheme, path, port or wildcard. IP addresses and whole domain registries are not accepted.
This site already has a rule. Edit the existing rule.
You can add up to 100 sites.
